name: Mir Madan
seoTitle: Mir Madan: Plassey Artillery Commander under Siraj ud-Daulah
seoDescription: Profile of Mir Madan, Siraj ud-Daulah's artillery commander at Plassey whose fatal battlefield wound affected the Nawab's camp.
contribution: Mir Madan commanded artillery and fought for Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah at the Battle of Plassey on 23 June 1757.
context: He was one of the commanders who actively engaged the East India Company’s forces; his death during the battle weakened the Nawab’s effective resistance.
impact: Remembered in accounts of Plassey as a loyal fighting commander, Mir Madan represents the military resistance that confronted the Company’s advance.
